alate: The whole body is deep yellow, the compound eyes purplish brown, the wings pale brown, the body hairs golden yellow.
soldier: Head deep yellow, thorax and abdomen pale yellow. The head capsule is rectangular, the sides nearly parallel. In lateral view the frontal ridge is almost without elevation, and behind the fontanelle there is a shallow line. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the semi-transparent region at its apex short and pointed, bearing a pair of apical hairs and a pair of lateral-apical or subapical hairs, with occasionally a few bristles on the labral ridge. The mandibles are rather slender and long, their apices rather pointed and straight, the basal ridge of the outer margin indistinct. The lacinial margin of the maxilla with about ten hairs. Antennae with 14–15 segments. The pronotum is about 1.5–1.6 times as wide as long, the notches of the anterior and posterior margins distinct, the middle region almost hairless, a few individuals with one or two hairs, the marginal hairs about thirty.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed in the original work as Reticuliter mes, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Reticulitermes.
